tasks.label: check: current file
tasks.detail: ruff + mypy on the open file (.py or .ipynb); .pyn gets ruff + basedpyright via byname (mypy sees records as Any), plus scripts/any_check.py
tasks.command: F=$(echo '${file}' | cut -d'#' -f1); echo "checking $F"; echo; case "$F" in *.pyn) echo '─── ruff ───'; uv run byname tool ruff check --output-format=concise "$F" && echo '✅ ruff ok'; echo; echo '─── basedpyright ───'; uv run byname tool basedpyright "$F" && echo '✅ basedpyright ok'; echo; echo '─── untyped names (Any) ───'; uv run python scripts/any_check.py "$F" && echo '✅ no Any names';; *) echo '─── ruff ───'; uv run ruff check --output-format=concise "$F" && echo '✅ ruff ok'; echo; echo '─── mypy ───'; { case "$F" in *.ipynb) uv run nbqa mypy "$F";; *) uv run mypy "$F";; esac; } && echo '✅ mypy ok';; esac; echo
